paper: Shen, Horikawa, Majima, Kamitani (2019) Deep image reconstruction from human brain activity. PLOS Comput Biol. doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1006633
verified_from: OpenNeuro S3 dataset_description.json, README, BIDS session/func listings, imagery events.tsv; KamitaniLab github + figshare

ses-perceptionNaturalImageTraining.role: perception decoder training (NOT downloaded in C3X)

ses-perceptionArtificalImage.role: geometric shapes (not used in C3X primary)

perception_imagery_correspondence: category/image identity (imagery targets are the natural-image test set imagined by category); pixel/category-level, NOT merely semantic - to be certified from labels in Phase 3

roi_source.note: OpenNeuro BIDS contains raw BOLD only (no ROI masks). The field-standard preprocessed release provides VC-extracted per-subject bdpy .h5 with official V1/V2/V3/V4/VC ROIs and stimulus labels.

leakage_risks_audited.cue: imagery trials preceded by a 4s cue (event_type 1); cue names the target category - a semantic-cue confound to be noted; primary reliability uses the imagery window (event_type 2) only
leakage_risks_audited.post_stimulus: no stimulus is shown during imagery (pure recall)
leakage_risks_audited.run_structure: content repeated across runs -> use RUN-DISJOINT splits to avoid within-run leakage
leakage_risks_audited.vividness_selection: evaluation scores present but NOT used to select trials in primary reliability

access_status: PUBLIC (OpenNeuro CC0 raw; figshare CC-BY preprocessed)
qualification_note: PRIMARY C3X candidate: matched perception + imagery, multiple imagery runs, repeated identities, public, official visual ROIs.
